description: CallSieve public benchmark - TypeScript language slice. Four natural-language tasks target the pinned public VS Code extension sources in CallSieve to verify TypeScript indexing and retrieval coverage. This is a language-smoke slice, not a third-party SWE-bench-style claim.

issues.task: activate the VS Code extension and register CallSieve editor commands
show agent context results in VS Code with read first files snippets and status messages
spawn the CallSieve CLI from TypeScript and handle command failures
parse JSON responses for query context and status in the VS Code client
